supersedes: prompts-v5.json — REC-only rebuild. v5 measured all four intents and showed the funnel (absent > mentioned > shortlisted > recommended) is only measurable on recommendation intent: 81% of REC runs commit to a platform vs 13% howto and 8% evaluative, and comparison prompts are 99% absent by construction. v6 keeps only the funnel-bearing intent.

blocks.spine: 15 v5 REC prompts verbatim — carries the v5 funnel baselines and the re-measure targets (absent 29%->** <15%, shortlisted 63%->75%, recommended 12%->30%). Runs imported from results-v5, not re-run.
blocks.v2-reuse: 15 unbranded REC prompts verbatim from the v1/v2 46 — the kill prompts and short-shape twins. 4 double as v4 anchors and import their Aug 10 runs; 11 run fresh.
blocks.gap: 20 new prompts aimed at content-repo gaps (actions.json create rows and coverage voids); 9 are scenario twins of v2-reuse shorts.

factors.shape: short (~6-word nominal query, v2 style) vs scenario (situational chat phrasing, v5 style). 9 designed twin pairs identify the shape->surface effect WITHIN topic; the newest branch finding is that shape, not intent, decides whether engines read listicles or docs.

decisions.rec_only: howto and evaluative excluded on purpose — they are citation games, not recommendation games; a loss on REC is a lost customer.
decisions.no_versus_block: branded Railway-vs-X guarantees a mention by construction (all 10/10 in v2, zero discriminative power); unbranded competitor pairs were 99% absent by design in v5. Both are funnel-incompatible. v5's 15 VS prompts stand as the baseline for a future post-test once third-option pages exist.
decisions.reps: chatgpt x5, claude x3 — unchanged from v5 (Aug 8 determinism: Claude 98% deterministic cells, ChatGPT 54%).
decisions.reuse: spine (120 runs) and anchors (64 runs) imported from results-v5 (2026-08-10) rather than re-run: raw text persisted, stance-graded, hand-verified, and nothing on Railway's side changed since. Re-run the spine only if consumer-default models moved off gpt-5.6-luna / claude-sonnet-5 on run day. Block-vs-block contrasts mix two retrieval dates two days apart — under the noise floor, bounded by anchors.

runs.note: 432 = 50 grid prompts x 8 runs + 4 remaining anchor prompts x 8. 184 imported (120 spine + 32 anchor-doubled v2-reuse + 32 anchor); 248 paid calls on run day (31 prompts x 8).

design.gap_instrument: every gap_target names the page that would satisfy the prompt (actions.json create rows). A later wave on the same prompts measures whether shipping the page moved the funnel — pre/post.
